advisories.summary: Artifex Software, Inc.
advisories.details: Artifex Software, Inc. MuJS before a5c747f1d40e8d6659a37a8d25f13fb5acf8e767 allows context-dependent attackers to obtain sensitive information by using the "opname in crafted JavaScript file" approach, related to an "Out-of-Bounds read" issue affecting the jsC_dumpfunction function in the jsdump.c component.

advisories.summary: A use-after-free vulnerability was observed in Rp_toString function of Artifex Software, Inc.
advisories.details: A use-after-free vulnerability was observed in Rp_toString function of Artifex Software, Inc. MuJS before 5c337af4b3df80cf967e4f9f6a21522de84b392a. A successful exploitation of this issue can lead to code execution or denial of service condition.

advisories.summary: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability was observed in Sp_replace_regexp function of Artifex Software, Inc.
advisories.details: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability was observed in Sp_replace_regexp function of Artifex Software, Inc. MuJS before 5000749f5afe3b956fc916e407309de840997f4a. A successful exploitation of this issue can lead to code execution or denial of service condition.

advisories.summary: Artifex Software, Inc.
advisories.details: Artifex Software, Inc. MuJS before a0ceaf5050faf419401fe1b83acfa950ec8a8a89 allows context-dependent attackers to obtain sensitive information by using the "crafted JavaScript" approach, related to a "Buffer Over-read" issue.

advisories.summary: Artifex Software, Inc.
advisories.details: Artifex Software, Inc. MuJS before 5008105780c0b0182ea6eda83ad5598f225be3ee allows context-dependent attackers to conduct "denial of service (application crash)" attacks by using the "malformed labeled break/continue in JavaScript" approach, related to a "NULL pointer dereference" issue affecting the jscompile.c component.

advisories.summary: An integer overflow vulnerability was observed in the regemit function in regexp.c in Artifex Software, Inc.
advisories.details: An integer overflow vulnerability was observed in the regemit function in regexp.c in Artifex Software, Inc. MuJS before fa3d30fd18c348bb4b1f3858fb860f4fcd4b2045. The attack requires a regular expression with nested repetition. A successful exploitation of this issue can lead to code execution or a denial of service (buffer overflow) condition.

advisories.summary: The chartorune function in Artifex Software MuJS allows attackers to cause a denial of service (out-of-bounds read) via a * (asterisk) at the end of the input.
advisories.details: The chartorune function in Artifex Software MuJS allows attackers to cause a denial of service (out-of-bounds read) via a * (asterisk) at the end of the input.

advisories.summary: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Fp_toString function in jsfunction.c in Artifex Software MuJS allows attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) via crafted input.
advisories.details: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Fp_toString function in jsfunction.c in Artifex Software MuJS allows attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) via crafted input.

advisories.summary: Artifex Software MuJS allows attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) via vectors related to incomplete escape sequences.
advisories.details: Artifex Software MuJS allows attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) via vectors related to incomplete escape sequences.  NOTE: this vulnerability exists due to an incomplete fix for CVE-2016-7563.

advisories.summary: Integer overflow in the js_regcomp function in regexp.c in Artifex Software, Inc.
advisories.details: Integer overflow in the js_regcomp function in regexp.c in Artifex Software, Inc. MuJS before commit b6de34ac6d8bb7dd5461c57940acfbd3ee7fd93e allows attackers to cause a denial of service (application crash) via a crafted regular expression.

advisories.summary: regexp.c in Artifex Software, Inc.
advisories.details: regexp.c in Artifex Software, Inc. MuJS allows attackers to cause a denial of service (NULL pointer dereference and crash) via vectors related to regular expression compilation.

advisories.summary: Heap-based buffer overflow in the js_stackoverflow function in jsrun.c in Artifex Software, Inc.
advisories.details: Heap-based buffer overflow in the js_stackoverflow function in jsrun.c in Artifex Software, Inc. MuJS allows attackers to have unspecified impact by leveraging an error when dropping extra arguments to lightweight functions.

advisories.summary: An issue was discovered in Artifex Software, Inc.
advisories.details: An issue was discovered in Artifex Software, Inc. MuJS before 4006739a28367c708dea19aeb19b8a1a9326ce08. The jsR_setproperty function in jsrun.c lacks a check for a negative array length. This leads to an integer overflow in the js_pushstring function in jsrun.c when parsing a specially crafted JS file.

advisories.summary: An issue was discovered in Artifex Software, Inc.
advisories.details: An issue was discovered in Artifex Software, Inc. MuJS before 8f62ea10a0af68e56d5c00720523ebcba13c2e6a. The MakeDay function in jsdate.c does not validate the month, leading to an integer overflow when parsing a specially crafted JS file.

advisories.details: A buffer overflow vulnerability was observed in divby function of Artifex Software, Inc. MuJS before 8c805b4eb19cf2af689c860b77e6111d2ee439d5. A successful exploitation of this issue can lead to code execution or denial of service condition.

advisories.details: jsparse.c in Artifex MuJS through 1.0.2 does not properly maintain the AST depth for binary expressions, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (excessive recursion) via a crafted file.

advisories.details: An issue was discovered in Artifex MuJS 1.0.5. The Number#toFixed() and numtostr implementations in jsnumber.c have a stack-based buffer overflow.

advisories.summary: An issue was discovered in Artifex MuJS 1.0.5.
advisories.details: An issue was discovered in Artifex MuJS 1.0.5. jscompile.c can cause a denial of service (invalid stack-frame jump) because it lacks an ENDTRY opcode call.

advisories.summary: An issue was discovered in Artifex MuJS 1.0.5.
advisories.details: An issue was discovered in Artifex MuJS 1.0.5. It has unlimited recursion because the match function in regexp.c lacks a depth check.

advisories.summary: An issue was discovered in Artifex MuJS 1.0.5.
advisories.details: An issue was discovered in Artifex MuJS 1.0.5. regcompx in regexp.c does not restrict regular expression program size, leading to an overflow of the parsed syntax list size.
